questions.prompt: What should the hello probe prove on this repo?
questions.distill: one line naming the behaviour the probe stands for

adoptionHandover.step: Add the Actions secret HELLO_TOKEN (any value)
adoptionHandover.breaks: the hello-asks-token task parks needs-human-action naming the secret
adoptionHandover.done: an executor run of hello-asks-token reads the secret

ruleRoutingGuidance.belongs: nothing but the adoption probe: proving that a pack's questions, seeds, handover and task secrets reach a member at adoption
ruleRoutingGuidance.excludes: every real rule, skill or check — the pack that owns its subject

pitch: The adoption probe. It asks one question, seeds one file, hands over one step and declares one task secret, so a rehearsal can see cn init and cn adopt carry each through. It belongs only on repos that test Claudinite itself.
